sample_type.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/5] The sample comprised all full-time or part-time employed women who both in 1998 at age 43 (n = 312) and in 2004 at age 49 (n = 317) took part in a personal interview (including hand-outs) and also took part in an intensive psychological and medical examination. The interview population constituted all now living women in the IDA cohort who resided in the O¨ rebro county or belonged to the IDA random medical sample. [/page/4/Text/6] The Lithuanian sample comprised 271 women from various organizations and industries in Vilnius, the capital city of Lithuania. The sample was randomly selected from lists of employees, within the specified age range of 40 to 46 (M = 42.41, SD = 2.13).
